env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run . 6
stdout '^123 11 6 \[7 8 0 9 10 11\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
! logos run . 6 exhaust
stderr '^panic: arena: fixed region exhausted \(want 1, have 0\)$'

logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run . 6
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
! exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run . 6 exhaust
stderr '^panic: arena: fixed region exhausted \(want 1, have 0\)$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenadynamic

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	"example.com/arenadynamic/fill"
	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	buf := make([]byte, n)
	r := arena.OpenFixed(buf)
	order, last := fill.Write(r)
	fmt.Println(order, last, arena.FixedUsed(r), buf)
	if len(os.Args) > 2 {
		fill.Exhaust(r)
	}
}

-- m/fill/fill.lgo --
package fill

import "logos/arena"

//go:noinline
func Write(r arena.Region) (int, byte) {
	order := 0
	mark := func(digit int) int {
		order = 10*order + digit
		return 2
	}
	p := arena.New[byte](r)
	*p = 7
	s := arena.Make[byte](r, mark(1))
	s[0] = 8
	s = arena.Append(r, arena.Append(r, s, byte(7+mark(2))), tail(mark(3))...)
	return order, s[len(s)-1]
}

func tail(n int) []byte {
	return []byte{10, 11}[:n]
}

func Exhaust(r arena.Region) {
	arena.New[byte](r)
}
